input.text: Article 10 of the Convention on the Law of the Sea applies, and Article 11 thereof also applies.

references.literal: Article 10 of the Convention on the Law of the Sea
references.external_instrument: Convention on the Law of the Sea
Convention on the Law of the Sea

_note: 'Convention on the Law of the Sea' is a treaty — the head is the FIRST instrument keyword ('Convention') not inside an 'on' complement, never the LATER 'of' inside 'the Law of the Sea' (the old rightmost-keyword rule would have no second keyword here to confuse it, but this shows the head noun carries through to 'Article 11 thereof' correctly resolving by KIND against this treaty, not the UK host Act). Constructed wording.
